The '''Thunderbolt Shock Prod''' was a type of [[Electroprod/Legends|shock prod]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. A nearly two [[Meter/Legends|meter]] solid alloy [[Staff/Legends|staff]], the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] had an insulated, two-handed grip on one end and sharp prongs on the other that generated an arc of powerful, [[Stun/Legends|non-lethal]] electricity able to tame a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />

Infamous throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Thunderbolt had a mixed reputation as a brutal [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] symbolic of rural agricultural life and oppressive regimes. Favored by [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary security forces]] and [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], the Thunderbolt was used to herd thick-skinned [[Species/Legends|creatures]] and, on occasion, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. Able to induce crippling pain, the shock prod allowed riot [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] to disperse violent crowds in [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], its noisy electrical shock incapacitating even determined rioters.<ref name="Far Horizons" />

After [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="EotE date">The [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] establishes that ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' takes place after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an event that occurred during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], dated by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict waged by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Thunderbolt Shock Prod sold for 875 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thunderbolt Shock Prod was mentioned in ''[[Far Horizons]]'', a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook authored by<ref name="Far Horizons" /> [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' RPG manager<ref name="LinkedIn">{{LinkedIn|url=in/sam-stewart-b4593744|text=Sam Stewart|archivefile=File:Sam Stewart LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and lead developer [[Sam Stewart]] and published by FFG in [[2014]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />
